property_summary: After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the state variable openToPublic is always false.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the value of openToPublic remains unchanged from before the call.
After a call to AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's OpenToThePublic function (which returns the openToPublic state variable) returns the same value before and after the call.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the value returned by OpenToThePublic() is true (i.e., openToPublic remains true).
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any amount, the value of OpenToThePublic() is the same as it was before the call.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called, the return value of AdjustDifficulty equals the current betLimit
After AdjustBetAmounts, the value returned by AdjustDifficulty should match the current difficulty.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the value returned by currentDifficulty must change only when AdjustDifficulty is called directly.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the value returned by currentDifficulty should remain unchanged.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the return value of currentDifficulty() equals the value of difficulty before the call.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called with any value, calling wager with the new betLimit always succeeds (does not revert) in the reference contract.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets a new betLimit, calling wager with msg.value != betLimit always reverts (fails) in the reference contract.

After AdjustBetAmounts sets a new betLimit, calling wager with msg.value != betLimit always refunds the sent ether (the contract balance increases only by the wager of the test caller) while calling wager with msg.value == betLimit does not refund (contract balance increases by the full wager).
After AdjustBetAmounts sets a new betLimit, calling wager with msg.value equal to the new betLimit always succeeds in the reference contract.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets betLimit to any value L, calling wager with msg.value = L should succeed (not revert) in the reference contract.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any amount, the wager mapping for any address remains unchanged from its value before the call.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the wager mapping for any address remains unchanged from its value before the call.
AdjustBetAmounts does not change the wager status of any address.
AdjustBetAmounts does not modify the wager status of any address.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, no previously wagering address becomes non-wagering.
The total number of distinct players who have wagered (i.e., whose wager balance is > 0) equals the number of wager calls that succeeded, which is invariant when adjusting bet limits.
After AdjustBetAmounts, the player's wager amount equals the new bet limit if they had wagered previously, else zero.
After AdjustBetAmounts(), for any address that had wagered previously, the wager balance equals the old bet limit (not the new one).
After AdjustBetAmounts, if a player has previously wagered, their wager balance equals the new bet limit; otherwise it is zero.
After AdjustBetAmounts, for each address that had wagered before, the wager amount remains the old bet limit (unchanged by the call).
After a call to AdjustBetAmounts with a valid amount, the wager mapping for the caller remains unchanged.
After any sequence of operations ending with a call to AdjustBetAmounts, the wager mapping for the caller (msg.sender) is unchanged.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called, the recorded wager amount is always equal to the betLimit sent by the player.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called, the recorded wager amount is always exactly equal to the betLimit set by the contract owner.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets the betLimit to a value L, any subsequent call to wager() with msg.value == L results in wagers[sender] being equal to L.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets the betLimit to a value L, a subsequent call to wager() with msg.value == L results in the player's recorded wager being exactly L, not doubled.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called, the player's wager is exactly equal to the amount they sent.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the betLimit state variable equals the amount passed to the function.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any uint256 value, the contract's wagered state for the caller remains zero if they had not previously wagered.
The betLimit state variable remains unchanged after calling AdjustBetAmounts when the caller is not the owner.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's openToPublic state variable remains unchanged (i.e., it stays false) if the caller is not the owner.
After AdjustBetAmounts is called with a non-zero wager by the owner, the winner's pot is unchanged if no previous wager was placed.
The wagers mapping for the caller is zero after calling AdjustBetAmounts only through an EOA (non-contract) caller.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's balance is unchanged (the call does not transfer value).
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's balance is unchanged (the call does not transfer value).
The AdjustBetAmounts function does not revert when called by an externally-owned account (tx.origin == msg.sender).
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the contract's betLimit state variable is set to the passed argument regardless of the caller type.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any amount, the betLimit state variable equals that amount regardless of the caller.
After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the wagers mapping for msg.sender remains zero, regardless of who calls.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the wagers mapping for the caller remains unchanged from before the call.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the caller's wager balance remains zero if the caller has never wagered before, regardless of who calls.
After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the return value of hasPlayerWagered(caller) is always false.
The bet limit remains unchanged after calling AdjustBetAmounts with any valid value.
After any call to AdjustBetAmounts, the new bet limit is equal to the argument passed.
After calling AdjustBetAmounts, the value of winnersPot() equals half of the contract's balance.
After any AdjustBetAmounts call, the value of winnersPot() is exactly half of the contract's balance when difficulty is 1.

After calling AdjustBetAmounts with any value, the probability of winning (determined by the condition winningNumber == difficulty/2 in the reference) is always 50% when difficulty is 2, but the mutant changes the condition to winningNumber == difficulty, making it impossible to win when difficulty > 1.
The total donated amount after a play() call where the player loses should equal the betLimit divided by 2 (the amount sent to the whale).
After losing a play, the wagers mapping for the player should be cleared (zero) regardless of how betLimit changes.

After AdjustBetAmounts sets a new betLimit, at least one successful play() call by a non-owner address sends only betLimit/2 to the whale when the player loses, preserving the contract balance accordingly.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets betLimit, when a non-owner player loses a play, the amount sent to the whale equals betLimit/2 in the reference, but betLimit in the buggy version.
After AdjustBetAmounts sets a new betLimit, a losing play() call should send exactly betLimit/2 wei to the whale.
